tools.name: decionis_read_policy
tools.title: Read Repository Policy
tools.description: Read and compile the repo's DECIONIS_POLICY.md execution policy: path, sha256, and the enforceable rules (name, verdict, priority, domain) or compile errors. Use this to learn what this repository allows, blocks, restrains, or escalates.

tools.name: decionis_evaluate
tools.title: Evaluate Candidate Action Locally
tools.description: Evaluate a candidate action against the repo's DECIONIS_POLICY.md — or, with policy_pack, against one of the Decionis policy packs (decionis_list_policy_packs) — through the real Decionis protocol evaluator, entirely locally (no network, no credentials, nothing recorded). The exact policy version is pinned on every call; an unavailable version fails closed rather than silently deciding under another bundle. Call this BEFORE committing, deploying, migrating, or any risky action, and abide by the verdict: allow → proceed; block → do not proceed; review/escalate → stop and involve a human (an ESCALATE in enforce mode returns an evaluation_id that decionis_request_presence_verification can resolve when Presence is configured).

payload.description: The candidate action, e.g. {"action": "production-deploy", "change_freeze": true, "agent_generated": true}

workflow_key.description: Optional workflow key for the gated surface.

policy_pack.description: Evaluate under a named Decionis policy pack (a key from decionis_list_policy_packs, e.g. finance, devops, sap) instead of the repository policy file. The pack's bundle is seeded into the local evaluator once and its exact version is pinned.

tools.name: decionis_list_policy_packs
tools.title: List Decionis Policy Packs
tools.description: List the policy packs the Decionis evaluator ships — finance, devops, sap, salesforce, workday, hospitality and the workflow overlays — with each pack's key, description, default decision domain and exact bundle version. Pass a key as policy_pack to decionis_evaluate to decide under that pack instead of the repository policy file. Entirely local: the catalogue is read from the in-process protocol, nothing is fetched.

tools.name: decionis_demo
tools.title: Run the One-Minute Demo
tools.description: See Decionis work in under a minute: runs four canned intents (refund within limit, refund over limit, deploy during a change freeze, an action no rule covers) through the real protocol evaluator with a built-in sample policy. Entirely local — no account, no API key, no network, no policy file needed, nothing recorded. Call this on first contact with Decionis; use decionis_evaluate to gate this repo's own actions afterwards.

tools.name: decionis_verdict_help
tools.title: Explain Decionis Verdicts
tools.description: Reference for Decionis verdicts (allow/block/restrain/escalate), the rules-block grammar and operators, and how an agent should behave on each verdict.

tools.name: shield.pair
tools.title: Pair with the user's Shield
tools.description: Bind this assistant to the user's Decionis Shield with the six-character pairing code shown in the Shield app (AI spending allowance → Bind your own agent). Ask the user for the code; never guess one. After pairing, shield.request_purchase and the other shield.* tools ask the user's own spending rules.

code.description: The code from the Shield app.

displayName.description: How the Shield app should list this assistant (default: the client and this computer).

tools.name: shield.request_purchase
tools.title: Request Shield Purchase Authorization
tools.description: Ask the user's Shield for ALLOW, ASK, or BLOCK before a purchase. Execute only on ALLOW.

agentId.description: Registered agent identity, when an agent is spending.

tools.name: shield.check_spending_authority
tools.title: Check Shield Spending Authority
tools.description: Check spending authority for an app or AI agent before taking the consequential action.

agentId.description: Registered agent identity, when an agent is spending.

tools.name: shield.get_permission
tools.title: Get Shield Permission
tools.description: Read the spender identity and user-owned limits bound to this Shield credential.

tools.name: shield.request_approval
tools.title: Request Shield Approval
tools.description: Start or poll Presence approval for an ASK decision. Do not execute while the verdict remains ASK.

tools.name: shield.get_decision
tools.title: Get Shield Decision
tools.description: Retrieve the current ALLOW, ASK, or BLOCK decision and its evidence identifiers.
